description: This file defines the Configuration class for handling regional endpoint configurations in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for the S3 service. It includes methods for managing the endpoints type and fallback status.
external_files:
InvalidArgumentException (part of PHP core)
ConfigurationInterface (likely part of AWS SDK interfaces)

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Represents configuration options for AWS S3 regional endpoint handling, including endpoints type and fallback indicator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Configuration instance with the specified endpoints type and optional fallback status.

methods.name: getEndpointsType
methods.description: Returns the type of endpoints configured ('legacy' or 'regional').

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.

methods.name: isFallback
methods.description: Returns whether the fallback mode is enabled.
